_comment: CDC scenario INITIAL LOAD: PostgreSQL CDC over logical decoding (wal2json) of the domain's own replication slot (created with the domain, named after it, reused by the publisher); every model table REPLICA IDENTITY FULL, so the two keyless tables log their updates and deletes with whole before-images. wal2json carries the rows an ON DELETE CASCADE takes and an UPDATE that sets the values a row has: --cascades logged --noops logged. The stream starts over a seeded database: its initial load must be the database, and the changes after it the operations modify-data applied. STAGES: (1) domains -- create the postgrescdc domain, install employeescdc, load the xs seed, its operations appended to ${xp:dir}/ops.jsonl; (2) actions, tagged live -- `sentinel-data --key after-create-data`, so the load carries a key; (3) collections and (4) functions -- register postgrescdc_initial_load (initial_load=True), which STARTS it; (5) sentinel -- hold until after-create-data arrives: the load has flushed; (6) actions, tagged live -- one `modify-data --ops Mix --sets 5` pass, then `sentinel-data --key after-changes`; (7) sentinel; (8) actions, tagged check -- scripts/verify_cdc_ops.py --start initial-load: the snapshot is the state the seed left, the changes after it one by one, in the same transactions, each with its whole before-image and the row it leaves; nothing of audit; (9) monitor. Generated by gen_suites.py. Run: `tdd xp one-shot --suite cdc/postgrescdc_initial_load --keep`.
